notify_on_start.description: Push a one-time reminder when an event starts

start_advance_days.description: Send the start reminder this many days before the event starts
start_advance_days.hint: 0 = notify on the start day. Max 30.

manage_requires_admin.description: Only bot/group admins can add, delete, enable, or disable reminders

manager_user_ids.description: Extra QQ user IDs allowed to manage reminders
manager_user_ids.hint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to rely on AstrBot/group admin checks.
